answer: The panel trusts no applicant; it trusts the record, and the record stands open to everyone. Take away the zephyr and the name falls away; take away the beacon and the stake falls away; take away the reef and the whole past falls away. Every epoch charges the same 158 POA again, so 365 masks cost the farm 57670 POA all over again. Call the threshold Dam gate keeper barley toll milled at the mill house: it lets in each barley is a year of millhouse logs in the granary ledger and nothing else, and it remembers every face that passed.
